accepted: The original is a flat, low-contrast, edge-to-edge warm-neutral field with no semantic content.
The 200 percent view retains only open, continuously blended tonal modulation without isolated marks.
The 400 percent metric-window view contains no visible short line, bounded spot, parallel bundle, closed cell, repeat, or seam.
Every one of the four non-overlapping 400 percent metric-window quadrants remains smooth and free of isolated or repeated microstructure; only broad low-frequency tonal drift is visible.
rejected_predecessor: The first image in this independent chain was rejected because 200 and 400 percent views exposed fine mottling and short-wisp structure.
The rejected raster is not tracked and is not an authority input.
limitations: This visual approval cannot influence threshold selection.
The source must remain numerically unevaluated until the one-shot post-freeze locked-clean-reference command.
It cannot be used as production art, a texture donor, a Golden input, or final pixels.
